name: ET Carthage Loop Expansion
researcher_notes: Energy Transfer Partners added 32 miles of 42-inch pipe from Minden to Carthage, Texas, adding 500 MMcf/d. In service September 2008 (the EIA completed date is 10 September 2008). Sources: the August 2026 EIA pipeline projects release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 524 (32 mi, 42 in, 500 MMcf/d added, cost $94 million, intrastate, state authority, completed 2008-09-10). A 2008 Natural Gas Intelligence announcement of the expansion, which also says the project would add 500 MMcf/d at Carthage and was expected in service by September 2008. A 2008 Natural Gas Intelligence completion story that gives 32 miles Minden to Carthage and 42 inch. The two news stories are from one publisher but report separate events. The EIA release is a separate origin. No match found among existing rows. The only related row is the aggregate Texas Intrastate System (P0264), so this is staged as an expansion row under that parent name. It is separate from the Barnett-Texoma phases, which are the Cleburne to Carthage line. The 32 miles is the loop that doubles the Carthage end. EIA cost of $94 million is for this project alone. The news stories give about $260 million for this loop plus the Katy expansion. Endpoints are the towns named in the news story. Route not found. Intrastate line, so no FERC filing is expected. The Texas Railroad Commission map was not searched for the route. The Owner is Energy Transfer LP (exact hit in the gazetteer). EIA names the operator as Energy Transfer Co. Confidence high for existence and size; one independent publisher pair plus EIA.
